turns.question: In sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, what was the median number of minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median minutes from a session's first add-to-cart to its checkout, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Cart-to-checkout rate (the share of sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the add to cart's day or the day after), and the Cart sessions and Checkout sessions counts.
